opening.argument: The video walks viewers through buying cloud-mining pools while promising recurring payouts tied to the pool they hold. The speaker says pools pay every 24 hours, describes 1,000-day contracts, and shows mining-share purchase options priced at $1,000 and $5,000. The walkthrough also requires a one-time $99 enrollment payment to activate an account and directs viewers to pay a stated amount in Bitcoin Cash to a displayed invoice. Those specific prices, payout terms, and payment steps establish the promotion of paid mining returns. The available evidence does not establish whether the service operated, whether payouts were made, or whether viewers experienced losses.
